findings.description:
PhlimboEA._updatePool() (src/Phlimbo.sol#389-426) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- potentialReward = (rewardPerSecond * timeElapsed) / PRECISION (src/Phlimbo.sol#403)
	- accStablePerShare += (toDistribute * PRECISION) / totalStaked (src/Phlimbo.sol#410)
	- toDistribute = potentialReward (src/Phlimbo.sol#406)

PhlimboEA.pendingStable(address) (src/Phlimbo.sol#497-514) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- potentialReward = (rewardPerSecond * timeElapsed) / PRECISION (src/Phlimbo.sol#503)
	- _accStablePerShare += (toDistribute * PRECISION) / totalStaked (src/Phlimbo.sol#509)
	- toDistribute = potentialReward (src/Phlimbo.sol#506)
